stories.title: Prime Minister Announces Major UK Infrastructure and Clean Energy Investment
stories.summary: The UK Government has unveiled a landmark £30 billion capital investment strategy targeting railway electrification, modern energy grids, and regional regeneration across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

stories.title: Bank of England Holds Interest Rates as UK Inflation Stabilises at 2%
stories.summary: The Monetary Policy Committee voted to keep the Bank Rate steady, citing resilience in the UK services sector, steady GDP growth, and stabilised core inflation figures in line with Treasury projections.

stories.title: King Charles III and Royal Family Attend Commonwealth Service at Westminster Abbey
stories.summary: His Majesty The King, accompanied by The Queen and members of the Royal Family, joined diplomatic leaders and community champions for the annual celebration of Commonwealth cooperation in London.

stories.title: NHS Rolls Out Revolutionary AI Diagnostic Scanners Across 50 NHS Hospital Trusts
stories.summary: NHS England has deployed advanced artificial intelligence diagnostic imaging systems across English hospital trusts, dramatically cutting early detection times for oncology and cardiac conditions.

stories.title: Premier League Weekend Preview: Top Four Battle Heats Up in London & Manchester
stories.summary: Title contenders prepare for a pivotal weekend of Premier League action, featuring blockbuster derbies in Manchester and North London alongside crucial matches in Birmingham and Liverpool.

stories.title: UK Tech Sector Receives £5 Billion Funding Boost as London and Cambridge Lead AI Surge
stories.summary: Venture capital investment into the United Kingdom's tech and deep-science ecosystem reached a record quarterly high, led by artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and life sciences clusters in Cambridge, Oxford, and London.

stories.title: Met Office Issues UK Weather Warning as Atlantic Front Brings Heavy Rain and Strong Winds
stories.summary: Yellow weather warnings for wind and rain have been issued across western Scotland, Wales, and north-west England as an unseasonable low-pressure system moves in from the Atlantic.
